name: tabkeeper
description: Keeps a set of pinned editor tabs per Git branch and swaps them when you switch branches.

commands.title: Tabkeeper: Clear This Branch's Tab Set
Tabkeeper: Import Tab Set to This Branch...
Tabkeeper: Copy Tab Set to Branch...

tabkeeper.enabled.markdownDescription:
Turn automatic branch-to-tab synchronization on or off.

[Open Activity Log](command:tabkeeper.openActivityLog)  ·  [Open Saved Tab State](command:tabkeeper.openSavedState)

tabkeeper.preserveActiveDocument.description: Return focus to the document you were on before a branch switch.

enumDescriptions: Manage pinned tabs anywhere in the Git repository.
Manage pinned tabs only under this workspace folder.
tabkeeper.pinScope.description: How much of the working tree Tabkeeper manages tabs in.

tabkeeper.maximumRestoredTabs.description: Cap on how many tabs one branch switch opens and pins.

tabkeeper.restoreDelayMilliseconds.description: Wait after a checkout before restoring, so slow checkouts finish writing files.

enumDescriptions: Silently skip a saved tab whose file is gone (still logged).
Also show a warning notification for each missing file.
tabkeeper.missingFileBehavior.description: What to do when a saved tab's file does not exist on the branch.

enumDescriptions: Keep a per-commit pin set while HEAD is detached.
Unpin tabs and do not save or restore a set while HEAD is detached.
tabkeeper.detachedHeadBehavior.description: How to handle a detached HEAD state.

tabkeeper.pollingIntervalSeconds.description: How often the branch is re-checked if the file watcher misses a change.

tabkeeper.rules.description: Branch rules that share a tab set across branches, or disable synchronization for matching branches. The most specific pattern wins.

pattern.description: A case-insensitive branch glob, e.g. "feature/*". * matches any run of characters, ? matches one.

pinSetName.description: The shared tab set that matching branches use instead of their own.

enabled.description: true shares the set across matching branches; false leaves matching branches unmanaged.
